dataFlows.name: Template Selection (Thompson Sampling)
dataFlows.flow: opencode (TemplateSelector.select) → RPC HTTP Client → RPC API POST /v2/activities/templates/{id}/select → select_variant_thompson_sampling() → Beta distribution sampling → Return selected variant with metadata

dataFlows.name: Template Retrieval
dataFlows.flow: opencode (TemplateServiceClient.getTemplate) → CLI MCP gateway (metabob_get_activity_template) → RPC API GET /v2/activities/templates/{id} → Redis (cache hit) OR SurrealDB (cache miss) → Return template
